verdict.rationale: Mirrors is a developer tool with an SDK and hosted service, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The probe found no OpenAPI spec: every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is an LLM-oriented summary, not an API specification, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
